subject: C05
required_fixes: RF03 [P2, partially unresolved] Retire external learner state by the desktop learner generation, including changes while Academy is unmounted. .inputs/academy/src/lib/learner-identity.tsx:20 announces only userId while its provider is mounted, and learner-session.ts:20-23 ignores a repeated userId. DesktopShell unmounts Academy on entry to Settings (apps/desktop/src/shell/desktop-shell.tsx:134-143); LearnerProvider's new native-generation key does not change the identity passed to this external-state mechanism. Reproduction: queue a completion for account A, leave Academy, reset/sign out and sign back into A in Settings, then re-enter Academy. No guest provider announced the intervening retirement, so the old completion queue and course watch return. An independent in-memory probe using the actual identity provider, session module and completion component reproduced 'Module secure: BEFORE RESET MODULE' and an enabled watch of before-reset-course after remounting the same account under a new generation with presentation storage cleared. The new tests explicitly call announceLearner(null), which the real off-feature reset flow does not do. Acceptance: a composed desktop test performs this Settings/reset/re-sign-in flow without manually announcing identity changes and shows no previous completion, notice, answer state or course watch. Retirement must follow native generation/reset changes even while Academy is absent; preserve the now-working guest/account-B isolation.

RF01 [P2, partially unresolved] Make unknown-outcome recovery guidance match an available readback flow. .inputs/academy/src/features/units/components/knowledge-check-runner.tsx:297 now tells the learner to 'reload the unit to see your result before submitting again', but the runner initializes attempt/result to null at :140-142 and obtains a result only from submit success. The pinned units.get knowledge-check projection (.inputs/academy/src/server/routers/units.ts:802-808) returns metadata and quizDrawCount, not the prior attempt's grade. An independent component probe confirmed that after the unknown-submission alert, remounting the unit shows 'Start knowledge check', performs no result readback and loses the in-memory attempt/answers. Thus the remediation renders the uncertainty correctly but directs the learner to a recovery action that cannot show the promised result. Acceptance: either provide and test a supported readback that establishes the existing attempt's outcome without starting/submitting another mutation, or replace the instruction with an accurate available recovery path and explicitly retain uncertainty when the result cannot be recovered. Test the action described by the guidance, not only the alert text.
